remarks: Experience modern coastal luxury & everyday convenience at The Overlook, 71 Connecticut Avenue in Norwalk, CT. These refined residences feature upscale finishes, stainless-steel appliances, in-unit laundry & private balconies. Enjoy premium amenities like a fitness center, resident lounge, parking & controlled access. Perfectly positioned on Connecticut Avenue, you're moments from shops, dining, Wegmans & everyday essentials, with easy access to I-95, Route 1 & the South Norwalk train station. The vibrant SoNo district & Norwalk's waterfront attractions are just minutes away, offering the best in city-style living by the shore. Residents also benefit from free beach access to Calf Pasture & Shady Beach, ideal for morning runs, paddleboarding, or relaxing sunsets. The Overlook combines luxury, location & lifestyle for those who want it all, urban convenience, coastal charm & elevated living in one perfect address. This corner, oversized, sun-filled 2-bedroom unit features an open floor plan, private balcony, primary bedroom suite with walk-in-closet, spacious 2nd bedroom and hall bath. Enjoy in unit laundry ample closet storage. Images represent the same floor plan & design style. Finishes or exact unit placement may differ slightly. Some images are virtually staged. Rent includes: water, trash, sewer & amenities. 2 parking spaces can be requested for $50/month each.
